details: Rows loaded directly from the single specified raw OWID CSV.
Kept ISO-coded analytical entities, excluded the documented territory set, and retained Kosovo as the workbook's ISO-less exception.
Exactly one analytical record per Country-Year is required by the Tableau workbook.
Electricity/energy shares outside 0–100% were treated as invalid and blanked.
Missing derived fields filled only from exact source relationships or year-over-year source history.
